title: Deduplicate three field validators
prompt:
validators.py has three validators with duplicated length and type
checks. Extract one shared helper and reuse it.

Requirements:
- validate_name, validate_username and validate_bio must keep their names,
  signatures and exact behaviour, including their error messages.
- One private helper, _check_text, must perform the shared type and length
  checks, and all three validators must call it.
- Errors are raised as ValidationError with the same messages as before.

Current behaviour (preserve exactly):
- name: must be a str, 1-80 chars, else ValidationError('name must be text') or
  ValidationError('name length must be 1-80').
- username: must be a str, 3-20 chars, else ValidationError('username must be
  text') or ValidationError('username length must be 3-20').
- bio: must be a str, 0-280 chars, else ValidationError('bio must be text') or
  ValidationError('bio length must be 0-280').
Each returns the stripped value on success.

Only validators.py should change.
